description: Request a document workflow (states, transitions, who may act) on a DocType: create, update, activate or deactivate; the user approves it

workflow_name.description: The Workflow's name (create: a new one; others: an existing one)

doctype.description: create only: the DocType the workflow runs on

activate.description: create only, default 1. Activating deactivates the DocType's current workflow

states.description: create; update replaces the whole list. The FIRST state is where new documents start (doc_status 0)

state.description: Workflow State name (created when missing), e.g. Pending Approval

doc_status.description: 0 draft, 1 submitted, 2 cancelled; 1 and 2 only on submittable DocTypes

allow_edit.description: Role that may edit the document in this state

update_field.description: Optional fieldname set when the document enters this state

evaluate_as_expression.description: 1 = update_value is a Python expression on doc

message.description: Shown on the form in this state

style.description: Colour of a NEW Workflow State record

transitions.description: create; update replaces the whole list

action.description: Button label, e.g. Approve (Workflow Action created when missing)

allowed.description: Role that may take this action

allow_self_approval.description: Default 1. 0 = the document's creator cannot take it

condition.description: Optional Python expression on doc, e.g. doc.grand_total > 10000

override_status.description: 1 = do not let the workflow state override the list status

sample_document.description: Optional document name to evaluate conditions on (default: the latest one)

purpose.description: One line: why the user wants it (shown on the card)
